title: 天皇賞（春）の後に・リザルト

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Biwa Hayahide wins the spring Tenno Sho. But even so, the racing world still sees her as no more than Narita Brian's sister.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: If the venue for the race hadn't been changed, Biwa Hayahide could've maximized the results of her equation and put on an even better performance…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But she reminds me that there's no use dwelling on something we had no control over and urges me to focus on the future instead.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Our next goal is the exclusive Takarazuka Kinen, where only the best are chosen to race. We begin working hard so Biwa Hayahide can show the racing world just how strong she is.
